This control system located at power station main control room, to enable the 
operator to raise and lower the load of the unit and also correcting the some 
factors as level, temperature, pressure ... etc by shift engineer.
The Operator 
Station Consist of:
MSP 
card, processor for CRT#1 , PART # (772B388G57)
MSP

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear appropriate 
 personal protective safety equipment as safety shoes
 and helmet
Wear the ground strap.
Tools and Equipment
Screw driver, nut driver, blower.
Spray video cleaner.
Ground strap, Card extractor.
Digital voltmeter (DVM).
Work to be Carried Out
Check the back up software for the cabinet.
Check the operation of net work card function 
 (data highway controller card (MHC card) by using (system highway errors) 
 diagram.
Clean all cabinet cards from dust by blower.
Check the cabinet status by using (system 
 status display) diagram.
Check the power supply status by leds on front 
 of power supply.
Check the performance of operator keyboard.
Check the operation of cabinet cooling fan.
Clean the printer.
Clean the two CRT.
Check the configuration program for printer.
Test the 
 operation of printer
